contexts.text: He passed over the passage of Jabbok () = the first insinuation...

The reason Jabbok = the first insinuation, is that it was a boundary of the Land of Canaan... Thus also the ford or passage of Jabbok, which, relatively to the Land of Canaan was beyond the Jordan, and was the boundary of the inheritance of the sons of Reuben and Gad. Illustrated. The reason it fell to them as an inheritance, was that by Reuben was represented faith in the understanding, or doctrine, which is the first of regeneration... and by Gad were represented the works of faith... These (two things) are those through which the man who is being regenerated is insinuated into good. Hence it is that by the passage of Jabbok is signified the first insinuation.
For it was Jabbok which Jacob first passed over when he entered into the Land of Canaan, by which is signified the first insinuation of the affections of truth. References.
